budgets.each_case_queries: at most one event anchor and one lineage query
budgets.outcome_delay: responses immediate in this bounded query task; no temporal-adaptation claim

calibration_pool.hidden: proxy B, true event Y=B xor context orientation, copying L, potential anchor responses
calibration_pool.observable: three source bits encoded as x plus context; known a and copy prior .2

classification: Controlled grounding/observability robustness test and instantiation of established impossibility/active-learning ideas; no novel-theorem or worldwide-first claim
controls: unlabeled/provenance transcripts invariant to orientation; .5 anchors are uninformative but learner still assumes .9; echo anchors violate independence and grounding. KnownOrientation is information-privileged and pays0, not a fair learned baseline.
coupling: 24 independent calibration pools =2 accuracies x12 seeds; each is evaluated counterfactually under4 context orientations x3 anchor mechanisms.288 evaluation worlds are NOT288 independent datasets. Raw source pool/held-out observable samples/noise uniforms shared across orientation/mechanism variants.
leakage: selectors receive x,known a and revealed responses only; responder owns raw labels. No held-out outcomes enter selection. Independent holdout RNG seed offset30000000. Model/prior/cost/methods frozen before scoring.
limits: synthetic exact semantic-orientation family; a and dependence known; only two contexts; no physical faults, real-world forecast proof, human cognition, representation-learning proof or native-engine integration.
loss: squared probability error if predicting or .15 if abstaining, plus actual query expense/128. Brier/ECE scored even when abstaining. ECE10 equal-width bins.
planning: posterior over each context orientation starts .5; full likelihood of each underlying case integrates B,L and conditions on observed anchor/lineage once. GreedyDecision minimizes one-query expected terminal decision risk+query cost/128; TwoStep uses two-query lookahead with stopping and replans until cap4. Explicit table and recursive solvers use same horizon,tie order,and epsilon1e-12. EntropyGreedy maximizes orientation entropy reduction while informative and budget remains; SRDETypedGate buys high-confidence-proxy anchors in least oriented context until posterior confidence .95 or cap.
primary: TwoStepTable minus GreedyDecision exact total loss in independent .9-reference family; same information, query cap and charges. Other comparisons exploratory.
question: Can provenance-only observations distinguish reversed source-to-target relationships, and can short decision lookahead or information-based query selection acquire useful grounding when abstention creates a decision-risk plateau?
secondary: EntropyGreedy as strong conventional information acquisition; uniform/confident anchors; typed-gate heuristic; no-query robust abstention; provenance-only; literal assumption; privileged known orientation; lower/higher source accuracy and echo/uninformative controls; Brier,ECE,coverage,wrong accepted fraction,actual query counts.
uncertainty: 1000 bootstrap draws seed99101; sample12 seed clusters within each source accuracy, retain all counterfactual orientations/reference modes within a resampled cluster. Primary24 independent clusters. No independent-trial inference from forecast count.
